documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Exim Routes Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q4 and FY26, highlighting a 72% year-on-year increase in operating revenue to Rs. 207 crores and a 38% growth in EBITDA to Rs. 14.1 crores. Management discussed its growth pillars, emphasizing the role of its technology platform ERIS in driving operating leverage and reducing below-the-line costs. The company also outlined its capital allocation strategies, including new debt facilities and invoice financing initiatives to support working capital.

guidance.claim: Management targets full-year FY27 revenue growth between 30% to 50%, aiming to reach Rs. 300 crores at the upper end.
guidance.quote: For the full-year FY27, our business target is 30% to 50% of revenue growth, top line and bottom line, aiming to hit 300 crores of revenue at the upper end.

orders_capacity.claim: The company aims to scale to 10,000 containers moved this year.
orders_capacity.quote: And our aim is to scale to 10,000 containers this year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company started onboarding invoice financing partners with initial limits of 2.5 crores and aims to expand it to 15 crores during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: We have already started the process of onboarding invoice financing partners with initial limits of 2.5 crores and we aim it to expand to 15 crores this year.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth roughly tripled to Rs. 68.7 crore rupees following the December IPO.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net worth has roughly tripled to Rs. 68.7 crore rupees following our December IPO.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt as of 31st March was close to Rs. 16 crores against bank balances of more than Rs. 17 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 31st March, the total debt that we had was close to Rs. 16 crores against bank balances of more than Rs. 17 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to scale invoice financing limits to 15 crores throughout the year.
management_commitments.quote: We have already started the process of onboarding invoice financing partners with initial limits of 2.5 crores and we aim it to expand to 15 crores this year.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to scale container movement to 10,000 containers this year.
management_commitments.quote: And our aim is to scale to 10,000 containers this year.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets full-year FY27 revenue growth of 30% to 50%, aiming to hit Rs. 300 crores at the upper end.
management_commitments.quote: For the full-year FY27, our business target is 30% to 50% of revenue growth, top line and bottom line, aiming to hit 300 crores of revenue at the upper end.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
